standard_prerequisites.name: Kernel base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Restricts and pulls back relative equivalence kernels.

core_obligations: Fix a closed point s; the restrictions K_0 and K^prime_0 are relative equivalence kernels over Spec(k) by base change.
Compose to the kernel K_new on Y_0 x Y over S; its pullback to the special fibre is the identity kernel.
The rigidity lemma gives the trivialization over a neighbourhood of s; cover S by such neighbourhoods.
proof_roadmap: Build K_new from the restricted kernels, verify the special-fibre identity, then apply the rigidity lemma.
difficulty_reason: Reduction chain through kernel base change, category composition, and the rigidity lemma; fully displayed.
